thesis: Hold at the 12:30 ET tick. Sizing book is one name: VTI about $249 (~25% of ~$999 equity) and cash about $750 (~75%), inside the 15% cash floor, 35% single-name cap, and 6-position limit. Items published after 16:00Z and before the 16:30Z cutoff do not justify a rotation: MarketWatch reports the S&P 500 was trading within 2 percentage points of its record closing high while many stocks are in a bear market, a breadth description with no named issuer or quantified action; Federal Home Loan Bank of Atlanta and Chicago filed routine Item 2.03 debt-obligation 8-Ks; BayFirst Financial filed an Item 5.02 officer change. Context marks, still stamped 04:00-05:00Z, show the 10-year at 5.283% (+0.043pt), TLT at 78.04 (-0.74%), VIX at 16.30 (+1.43%), WTI at 90.35 (-2.43%), and USO -3.15%. Carryover remains junk bonds on track for their worst month since 2022 and a weak labor market. Cash is the ballast while yields are higher; the existing VTI sleeve already holds broad large-cap exposure. This tick supplies no quantified catalyst to add a second name, add duration, buy the oil decline, or resize VTI.
